name: context-bar
description: A stacked context-window bar above the prompt, colored like /context, with cost estimates, compaction and cost warnings, and per-subagent cache tracking. Toggle with /context-bar.

sessionCostWarnUsd.title: Session cost warning (USD)
sessionCostWarnUsd.description: Warn when the session's total cost passes this amount, and again at each doubling.

requestCostWarnUsd.title: Per-request cost warning (USD)
requestCostWarnUsd.description: Warn when re-sending the current context on a cold cache would cost more than this per request.

compactWarnPercent.title: Compaction warning (%)
compactWarnPercent.description: Warn when context reaches this share of the auto-compact threshold.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto works the cache lifetime out per loop from what Claude Code reports, the billing type and observed cache reads. 5m or 1h forces it for every loop.

maxSubagentRows.title: Subagent rows
maxSubagentRows.description: How many subagent lines the bar shows at most.
